title: Grill round 2: follow-ups on base precedence, the Base line and multiple PRs per repository

stale-stored-base.title: The stored base is first. What happens when the agent moved the branch onto another base?
stale-stored-base.display: Stored base first, unless git proves it stale; then the agent's base

base-line-conflict.title: The agent's `Base:` line and its link name different branches. Which is "the agent's base"?
base-line-conflict.display: The `Base:` line wins; the confirm list flags the mismatch

extra-heads-trust.title: Which branches may Create all PRs open a PR *from*, besides each repository's live checkout?
extra-heads-trust.display: Any branch on that repository's remote that a proposal names; shown in the confirm list **unchecked** by default

extra-pr-stamping.title: How are the extra PRs recorded on the task?

single-repo-multi.title: A **single-repository** task whose reply proposes two PRs: does it get this too?
single-repo-multi.display: Yes: show Create all PRs (with the same confirm list) on single-repo tasks with more than one proposal

c-extra-base.title: Base for an extra (non-live-head) PR
c-extra-base.value: The stored create-time base belongs to the task branch only. An extra PR's base is the agent's base (`Base:` line, then link), then the remote default. It's editable in the confirm list.

c-extra-head-pushed.title: An extra head that isn't on the remote
c-extra-head-pushed.value: Shown disabled in the confirm list: "branch `<x>` isn't on origin". No PR is attempted.

c-proposal-key.title: Which proposal is current
c-proposal-key.value: The newest matching proposal per (repository, head) across runs, extending your round-1 Q7 answer from per-repository.

c-duplicate.title: Duplicate PRs
c-duplicate.value: A head already stamped (live or extra) is skipped. A forge "a pull request already exists" answer is shown as "already open" (with the URL when the forge returns one), not as a failure.

c-base-line-prompt.title: Where the `Base:` line goes
c-base-line-prompt.value: Both prompts (single and multi) ask for a `Base: <branch>` line right above the link, inside each repository's block for multi.
